title: Generalizing Hate Speech Detection Using Multi-Task Learning: A Case Study of Political Public Figures
reasoning: The paper includes a specific evaluation and analysis of hate speech related to religion, specifically focusing on Islam and Islamophobia. It identifies 'Islam' as one of six primary topics for problematic speech, uses religious keywords for its topical categorization (e.g., 'muslim', 'islamic', 'religionofpeace'), and benchmarks the model's ability to distinguish these topics in its embedding space.
